message.reasoning_content:
The earnings-preview-hub claim is clearly false — Apple never guided to 25% revenue growth or $9.50 EPS for FY25. Apple doesn't give annual guidance anyway (stopped in 2020), and FY24 EPS was $6.08 (depressed by tax charge); 25% revenue growth to ~$489B is implausible. I'll disregard.

Let me do one more search for corroborating Q4 details/net income, maybe Apple's 8-K or other source.
